text:
**Ra.One** centers on a new technology developed by Jenny Nair at Barron Industries, allowing digital elements to enter the real world. Shekhar Subramaniam, a programmer, creates a video game where the protagonist, G.One (played by Shah Rukh Khan), fights the antagonist, **Ra.One** (played by Arjun Rampal). Ra.One is characterized by being faceless and possessing significantly greater powers than G.One, including shapeshifting and mind reading, as it is imbued with a self-learning AI.
The narrative escalates when the self-aware Ra.One breaks free from the game using the new technology, leading to the murder of Shekhar Subramaniam. G.One eventually enters the real world through Jenny's computer, leading to a battle with Ra.One. Through various encounters, G.One eventually defeats Ra.One, absorbs its remains, and transports himself back to the digital world. The film also faced controversies regarding South Indian representation and plagiarism allegations, despite winning technical awards like the National Film Award and Filmfare Award for Best Special Effects.
